description: Measures /flow-product-planning discovery plan quality and per-run cost across five recorded-task scenarios (internal change, UI change, methods-plus-target, revision pass, researchable), for issue #891's before and after comparison of the discovery instruction payload. Both arms pin the parent model (opus) as a measurement control only; production discovery keeps inheriting the session model. Plan quality is deterministic: flow-plan-lint plus per-branch section graders; cost and turns are non-gating metrics.
